sentences.en: The graph shows the cumulative interest as a function of time.
sentences.zh: 这张图显示了随时间推移累积的利息。

sentences.en: Lost sleep has a cumulative effect, I've been told.
sentences.zh: 被告知缺乏睡眠会产生累积效应。

sentences.en: Her experience in sales has grown on a cumulative basis.
sentences.zh: 她的销售经验是逐步积累起来的。

senses.zh: 累积的，渐增的；累计的，总计的；累加的，聚积的
